format: Single Jet's Pizza carry-out and delivery restaurant in leased strip-center space (1,200 - 1,500 sq. ft.)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a single Jet's Pizza franchise ranges from $572,500 to $786,000. This includes $30,000 (or $15,000 if you qualify for the 50% military discount) that must be paid to the franchisor or affiliate.

fee.quote: The initial franchise fee is $30,000; except for certain franchises established pursuant to an Area Development Agreement as described above and for those franchisees which qualify for a military discount.
fee.note: $15,000 (50% military discount) if at least 20% owned by an active-duty member or veteran not dishonorably discharged. Area Development: $30,000 first, $25,000 second, $20,000 third, $15,000 each additional (minimum 3 franchises, $75,000; $37,500 with military discount). Fee may be waived for certain affiliate stores.

royalty.basis: acquired inventory (franchisee's cost of all inventory and supplies purchased), not sales
royalty.quote: Royalty Fee - All franchisees 12% of Acquired Inventory; minimum of $1,200 per month 15th day of each month

adFund.quote: Fees to the General Advertising Fund Up to 10% of Acquired Inventory when added to the Technology Fee
adFund.note: General Advertising Fund: up to 10% of Acquired Inventory combined with the Technology Fee (Technology Fee currently not imposed); current rate not printed. Required minimum of $3,800 per month on local advertising and regional advertising fund contributions. Regional fund currently 25¢ per box purchased (some regions) or a weekly flat fee from $0 to $1,000.

otherRecurring.name: Minimum local and regional advertising spend
otherRecurring.amount: a minimum per month of $3,800 on your own local advertising initiatives and for contributions required by any regional advertising fund

otherRecurring.name: Regional Advertising Fund
otherRecurring.amount: currently 25¢ per box purchased for ordinary expenses (for some regions) or a weekly flat fee ranging from $0 to $1,000.00 (counts toward the minimum advertising spend)

otherRecurring.name: Gift Card Program and Loyalty Program Administration Fees
Technology Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Up to 10% of Acquired Inventory when added to the Fees to the General Advertising Fund; currently not imposed

item19.note: We do not make any representations about a franchisee's future financial performance or the past financial performance of company-owned or franchised outlets.

special: Royalty is 12% of Acquired Inventory (the franchisee's cost of food, beverages, packaging and supplies), not a percentage of sales, with a $1,200 monthly minimum; the sales x royalty% model does not apply. Liquidated damages of $43,200 on termination for default. Administrative default fees up to $30,000. Item 7 assumes a lease (rent estimated $30,000 to $60,000 per year); real estate purchase excluded.
issues: FDD is the 2025 edition (Item 20 data through 2024). Current General Advertising Fund rate not printed; Item 11 says contributions are 'not currently required' while also saying you must pay the General Advertising Fee.
